parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
The circuit shown in Fig. 5.1 contains a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ and negligible internal resistance connected to four resistors $R_1$, $R_2$, $R_3$ and $R_4$, each of resistance $R$.

{{figure:9702_w21_21_q05_figure_5_1}}

Fig. 5.1

The current in $R_3$ is $0.30\text{ A}$ and the potential difference (p.d.) across $R_4$ is $2.4\text{ V}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the e.m.f. $E$ of the battery.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The battery in (b) is replaced with another battery of the same e.m.f. $E$ but with an internal resistance that is not negligible.

State and explain the change, if any, in the total power produced by the battery.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The resistors in the circuit of Fig. 5.1 are made from nichrome wire of uniform radius $240\,\mu\text{m}$. The length of this wire needed to make each resistor is $0.67\text{ m}$.

Calculate the resistivity of nichrome.
